prompt: What are some alternatives to traditional PPC advertising agencies?
jawaban:
1. Upwork – upwork.com – Connects you with vetted freelance PPC specialists for flexible, project‑based campaign management.  
2. Fiverr – fiverr.com – Offers affordable, on‑demand PPC freelancers who can set up and optimize ads without a full‑service agency.  
3. Google Ads Smart Bidding – ads.google.com – Uses Google’s AI to automate bid strategies and budget allocation, letting you run campaigns yourself.  
4. Albert AI – albert.ai – An autonomous AI platform that creates, tests, and scales PPC campaigns end‑to‑end without human intervention.  
5. Acquisio – acquisio.com – Provides a self‑service dashboard with automated bidding, reporting, and optimization tools for in‑house teams.  
6. HubSpot Marketing Hub – hubspot.com/products/marketing – Integrates PPC tracking with inbound marketing tools, enabling DIY campaign creation and measurement.  
7. The Trade Desk – thetradedesk.com – A programmatic buying platform that lets brands directly purchase and manage display, video, and audio ads.  
8. Criteo – criteo.com – Offers a self‑service performance display solution that optimizes retargeting and acquisition campaigns.  
9. SEMrush PPC Toolkit – semrush.com/features/ppc – Supplies keyword research, ad copy ideas, and automation features for marketers to run PPC independently.  
10. Meta Business Suite – business.facebook.com – Allows you to create, launch, and optimize Facebook and Instagram ads in a single, agency‑free interface.
